title: The kernel of a morphism of quasi-coherent modules is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] between quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\ker\varphi$ be the kernel of $\varphi$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, i.e. the sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $U\mapsto\ker(\varphi_U:\mathcal F(U)\to\mathcal G(U))$ of $\mathcal F$ (for every open $U\subseteq X$). Then $\ker\varphi$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module.
